about_the_game:
Hidden Pairs 3: Lovely Birds invites you into a cozy world of feathered friends and peaceful landscapes. 🌿🐦

Search and find hidden birds and matching items in beautifully illustrated scenes. This charming twist on the classic hidden object genre lets you test your observation skills while enjoying a soothing and cozy gameplay experience.

🌸 A Cozy Hidden Object Adventure

  • Lovely Birds Everywhere 🐦 – Spot colorful parrots, tiny hummingbirds, and playful songbirds hidden among flowers, trees, and gardens.

  • Hidden Pairs Puzzle 🔍 – Match adorable birds and related items to complete each scene. It’s a fresh take on hidden object games that blends relaxation with challenge.

  • Peaceful Atmosphere 🌿 – Collect shimmering water drops and fluttering butterflies as you explore calm and cozy landscapes.

🎶 Relax and Unwind

  • Soothing Soundscapes 🎼 – Gentle background music and nature sounds create a cozy, meditative atmosphere perfect for unwinding.

  • Play at Your Own Pace 🕊️ – Enjoy relaxed puzzle-solving or test yourself with more challenging modes.

✨ Key Features

  • A fresh hidden object game with 150+ cozy levels

  • 10 unique pair-matching mini-games for variety and fun

  • Replayable puzzles for endless hidden object enjoyment

  • Collect Flower Cards and rescue lovely birds along the way

  • Beautiful artwork, relaxing music, and cozy design

  • Suitable for players of all ages – fun for kids and relaxing for adults

🌿🐦 Hidden Pairs 3: Lovely Birds – a cozy hidden object game where adorable birds, relaxing puzzles, and peaceful atmospheres await. Escape stress and enjoy hours of seek & find fun.
